method: each corrected texture is stored as runs of the texels that change; the compile adds the colours the palette lacks to unused entries and keeps format, size, mips, wrapper and allocation
source: b81-uniforms (beta 81): 2026 kit textures corrected against this season's game-highlight frames (refs/uniforms_2026), authored on the finished textures of the released v0.9 disc
